import sys
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext, ROUND_DOWN

# COBOL fixed-point: wide precision, truncation toward zero on store
getcontext().prec = 40

# ─── Working-Storage ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Table: 5 entries, each with CODE (X(3)) and QTY (9(4))
ws_code = ["   "] * 6          # 1-based, index 1..5 used; index 6 for AT END
ws_qty  = [Decimal(0)] * 6     # 1-based, PIC 9(4) -> 4 digits, no scale

ws_target = "   "              # PIC X(3)
ws_found  = "N"                # PIC X
ws_pos    = Decimal(0)         # PIC 9(2)
ws_total  = Decimal(0)         # PIC 9(6)
ws_hit_qty = Decimal(0)        # PIC 9(4)
ws_i      = Decimal(0)         # PIC 9(2)
ws_idx    = 1                  # INDEX for SEARCH (1-based integer)

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def accept_alpha(field_width: int) -> str:
    """ACCEPT into PIC X(n): read line, strip newline, take first field_width chars, pad/truncate."""
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        line = ""
    else:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")  # keep other whitespace
    # COBOL: left-justified, space-padded/truncated on right
    if len(line) >= field_width:
        return line[:field_width]
    return line.ljust(field_width)

def display_line(*parts: str) -> None:
    """One DISPLAY = one stdout line, concatenated exactly."""
    sys.stdout.write("".join(parts) + "\n")

def fmt_9n(value: Decimal, digits: int) -> str:
    """PIC 9(n): zero-padded to exactly n digits, no sign."""
    # Truncate high-order digits per COBOL SIZE ERROR rule (modulo 10**digits)
    # All fields here are unsigned (PIC 9), so simple modulo.
    v = int(value) % (10 ** digits)
    return f"{v:0{digits}d}"

def fmt_x(value: str, width: int) -> str:
    """PIC X(n): left-justified, space-padded/truncated to width."""
    if len(value) >= width:
        return value[:width]
    return value.ljust(width)

# ─── Paragraphs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def load_table() -> None:
    global ws_code, ws_qty
    ws_code[1] = "AAA"
    ws_qty[1]  = Decimal(120)   # 0120 -> 120
    ws_code[2] = "BBB"
    ws_qty[2]  = Decimal(45)    # 0045 -> 45
    ws_code[3] = "CCC"
    ws_qty[3]  = Decimal(1300)  # 1300
    ws_code[4] = "DDD"
    ws_qty[4]  = Decimal(7)     # 0007 -> 7
    ws_code[5] = "EEE"
    ws_qty[5]  = Decimal(888)   # 0888 -> 888

def main_para() -> None:
    global ws_target, ws_found, ws_pos, ws_total, ws_hit_qty, ws_i, ws_idx

    load_table()

    # ACCEPT WS-TARGET (PIC X(3))
    ws_target = accept_alpha(3)

    # SET WS-IDX TO 1
    ws_idx = 1

    # SEARCH WS-ENTRY AT END / WHEN WS-CODE(WS-IDX) = WS-TARGET
    # COBOL SEARCH: sequential search from current index (1) to end of table (5).
    # If found, index left at matching occurrence (1..5).
    # If AT END (not found), index left ONE PAST the table -> 6.
    found = False
    while ws_idx <= 5:
        if ws_code[ws_idx] == ws_target:
            found = True
            break
        ws_idx += 1
    if not found:
        ws_idx = 6  # AT END: one past the 5-entry table

    if found:
        ws_found = "Y"
        ws_hit_qty = ws_qty[ws_idx]  # MOVE WS-QTY(WS-IDX) TO WS-HIT-QTY
    else:
        ws_found = "N"               # MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND
        # WS-HIT-QTY unchanged (remains 0)

    # SET WS-POS TO WS-IDX (numeric move: occurrence number -> PIC 9(2))
    ws_pos = Decimal(ws_idx)

    # PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
    # TEST BEFORE: loop while WS-I <= 5
    ws_i = Decimal(1)
    while ws_i <= 5:
        # ADD WS-QTY(WS-I) TO WS-TOTAL
        # WS-I is numeric PIC 9(2), used as subscript (1-based integer)
        idx = int(ws_i)  # truncate to integer occurrence
        ws_total = ws_total + ws_qty[idx]
        # Truncate to PIC 9(6) on store (modulo 10**6)
        ws_total = Decimal(int(ws_total) % 1_000_000)
        ws_i = ws_i + 1
    # After loop, WS-I = 6 (first value > 5)

    # DISPLAY statements - exact byte output
    # DISPLAY "FOUND  " WS-FOUND
    display_line("FOUND  ", fmt_x(ws_found, 1))
    # DISPLAY "POS    " WS-POS
    display_line("POS    ", fmt_9n(ws_pos, 2))
    # DISPLAY "HITQTY " WS-HIT-QTY
    display_line("HITQTY ", fmt_9n(ws_hit_qty, 4))
    # DISPLAY "TOTAL  " WS-TOTAL
    display_line("TOTAL  ", fmt_9n(ws_total, 6))
    # DISPLAY "THIRD [" WS-CODE(3) "]"
    display_line("THIRD [", fmt_x(ws_code[3], 3), "]")

    # STOP RUN
    sys.exit(0)

# ─── Entry Point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main_para()

       PROGRAM-ID. TABLESUM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-TABLE.
           05  WS-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-IDX.
               10  WS-CODE     PIC X(3).
               10  WS-QTY      PIC 9(4).
       01  WS-TARGET           PIC X(3)     VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-FOUND            PIC X        VALUE "N".
       01  WS-POS              PIC 9(2)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-TOTAL            PIC 9(6)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-HIT-QTY          PIC 9(4)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-I                PIC 9(2)     VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM LOAD-TABLE
           ACCEPT WS-TARGET
           SET WS-IDX TO 1
           SEARCH WS-ENTRY
               AT END
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND
               WHEN WS-CODE(WS-IDX) = WS-TARGET
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-FOUND
                   MOVE WS-QTY(WS-IDX) TO WS-HIT-QTY
           END-SEARCH

           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               ADD WS-QTY(WS-I) TO WS-TOTAL

           DISPLAY "TOTAL  " WS-TOTAL
           DISPLAY "THIRD [" WS-CODE(3) "]"
           STOP RUN.

           MOVE 0120  TO WS-QTY(1)

           MOVE 0045  TO WS-QTY(2)
           MOVE "CCC" TO WS-CODE(3)

           MOVE "DDD" TO WS-CODE(4)
